findings.message: FR-4c calibration workflow (T3.2) is correctly authored, but its first invocation post-merge will return non-zero. The workflow shells out to .devcontainer/scripts/calibrate-gitnexus-grammar-skip.sh, which currently returns drift_detected (exit 2) against the npm-distributed gitnexus@1.6.5. This is a continuation of the upstream contract divergence already captured in Phase 2 (T2.5 surfaced the same underlying drift). The workflow YAML itself is sound (correct triggers, SHA pinning, permissions, concurrency, timeout); the failure-on-first-run is an upstream contract problem, not a Phase 3 defect. Documented in Issues/fr4b-signal1-regex-drift/analysis.md. Treat as deferred-MAJOR: remediation belongs to a Phase 5 follow-on task or a follow-up Issue (re-research T-001 against live gitnexus@1.6.5 OR loosen signal_1 to the original D-0006 recommendation pre-tightening). NOT a Phase 3 BLOCKER.
